import csv,json,os,sys,subprocess,tempfile,shutil
B='products/services/shopify-large-catalogue'
VH=['style_id','title','vendor','product_type','tags','color','size','sku','barcode','price']
IH=['style_id','color','position','url']
def wc(p,h,rows):
    with open(p,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        x=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n');x.writerow(h);x.writerows(rows)
src=tempfile.mkdtemp()
v=[['P%d'%i,'Prod %d'%i,'V','T','t','Black','40','SKU-%d'%i,'20000000000%d'%i,'10.00'] for i in range(3)]
im=[['P%d'%i,'Black','1','https://cdn.example.com/p%d.jpg'%i] for i in range(3)]
wc(src+'/v.csv',VH,v);wc(src+'/i.csv',IH,im)
res={'note':'Reproduction against UNMODIFIED code (commit before repair). Synthetic data.','defect1_split_overwrite':{},'defect2_runner_exit':{}}
for name in ['output.csv','output.CSV','output']:
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp();out=os.path.join(d,name)
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',B+'/transform.py','--variants',src+'/v.csv','--images',src+'/i.csv','--out',out,'--report',src+'/rep.json','--max-rows-per-file','1'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    rep=json.load(open(src+'/rep.json'))
    disk=sorted(os.listdir(d))
    skus=sorted(row['SKU'] for f in disk for row in csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(d,f),newline='',encoding='utf-8')) if row['SKU'])
    res['defect1_split_overwrite'][name]={'rc':r.returncode,'report_ok':rep['ok'],'reported_file_entries':len(rep['files']),'distinct_reported_paths':len(set(rep['files'])),'files_on_disk':disk,'skus_on_disk':skus,'all_3_preserved':skus==['SKU-0','SKU-1','SKU-2']}
c=tempfile.mkdtemp();shutil.copytree(B,c+'/s')
vp=c+'/s/tests/verify.py';t=open(vp).read()
assert '    chk.update(ok)\n    return chk' in t
open(vp,'w').write(t.replace('    chk.update(ok)\n    return chk',"    chk.update(ok)\n    chk['intentional_audit_failure'] = False\n    return chk"))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,c+'/s/tests/run_tests.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
res['defect2_runner_exit']={'patched_copy_only':True,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout_first_line':r.stdout.splitlines()[0] if r.stdout else '','stderr_tail':r.stderr[-300:]}
os.makedirs(B+'/repair',exist_ok=True)
json.dump(res,open(B+'/repair/repro-before.json','w'),indent=1)
print(json.dumps(res,indent=1))
